# 2 Chronicles 18 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 18 (34 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.4
- **EMET:** "And-he-said Jehoshaphat to king-of Israel seek please as-today word-of YHWH."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Inquire first for the word of the LORD.""
- **PNEUMA:** "But Jehoshaphat added, "First, let's find out what the LORD says.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.6
- **EMET:** "And-he-said Jehoshaphat is-there-not here still a-prophet of-YHWH and-we-may-seek from-him."
- **LOGOS:** "But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here another prophet of the LORD of whom we may inquire?""
- **PNEUMA:** "But Jehoshaphat asked, "Isn't there a prophet of the LORD here we can also consult?""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.12
- **EMET:** "And-the-messenger who went to-call Micaiah spoke to-him saying behold words-of the-prophets one mouth good to the-king and-let-be please your-word lik"
- **LOGOS:** "And the messenger who went to summon Micaiah said to him, "Behold, the words of the prophets with one accord are favorable to the king. Let your word "
- **PNEUMA:** "The messenger who went to get Micaiah said to him, "Look, the other prophets are unanimously predicting success for the king. Go along with them and s"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.19
- **EMET:** "And-He-said YHWH who will-entice Ahab king-of Israel and-he-shall-go-up and-he-shall-fall at-Ramoth-gilead and-he-said this one-saying thus and-this o"
- **LOGOS:** "And the LORD said, 'Who will entice Ahab the king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?' And one said one thing, and another said an"
- **PNEUMA:** "And the LORD said, 'Who will lure Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth-gilead to his death?' Various suggestions were made."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.22
- **EMET:** "And-now behold He-put YHWH a-spirit-of falsehood in-mouth-of these your-prophets and-YHWH spoke concerning-you evil."
- **LOGOS:** "Now therefore behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets. The LORD has declared disaster concerning you.""
- **PNEUMA:** "So you see — the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The LORD has decreed disaster for you.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.32
- **EMET:** "And-it-was as-saw commanders-of the-chariot that not was king-of Israel and-they-returned from-after-him."
- **LOGOS:** "For when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him."
- **PNEUMA:** "When the chariot commanders realized he wasn't the king of Israel, they stopped chasing him."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
